passes: live (Expo web preview, 375 px phone viewport)

findings.summary: Taps felt late: opening Sort re-rendered all 10 feed cards (memo defeated by inline callbacks), picking a sort blocked the JS thread 149 ms, first tap on Settings built the whole screen (101 ms). Fixed in 5b232e4.
Splash showed Expo's default image instead of the HackRadar mark (no expo-splash-screen config). Fixed in 5b232e4, visible from the next build.
Feed: about 30% of the screen is chrome before the first card (title, 2-line city banner, search, filter chips).
Filters and Sort live in a floating pill that covers cards and the pager and hides on scroll; Indian shopping/food apps put Filters and Sort at the start of the chip row under search.
No-city state is a permanent 2-line banner; location belongs in one tappable place (a city chip in the row).
Default filter chips (AI/ML, Online only) are solid brand teal, the loudest thing on the Feed, louder than the red 'closes soon' countdowns.
A green 'trusted' shield sits on almost every card next to the bookmark; a mark on every row carries no information. Show trust only when it needs attention.
Third tab is 'Settings' but holds the account and the person's feed preferences: it is a Profile, not settings.
Fee choice says 'Free only / Free and paid' in Settings but 'Free / Paid / Both' in Filters. Kept: Profile sets a default (2 choices), Filters is a one-off view (3 choices).
Tabs are the JS bottom tabs; NativeTabs is still 'unstable' on SDK 57, so kept (tab switches are instant after the prefetch fix).
